prepare.title: Download the Hive Hub MCP server and check its fingerprint (it needs Python 3.9+, which macOS and most Linux systems already have).
prepare.windows:
$d = "$env:USERPROFILE\.hive-hub-mcp"; mkdir $d -Force | Out-Null
irm https://kody-w.github.io/hive-hub-mcp/hive_hub_mcp.py -OutFile "$d\hive_hub_mcp.py"
if ((Get-FileHash "$d\hive_hub_mcp.py" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne "2A07829ED2057CB32FA49EA2B7FBAF14C1D69A6F8AD31EB935616BEFFAA9ED3E") { throw "fingerprint mismatch" }
python "$d\hive_hub_mcp.py" --version

consent: It downloads one open-source file, the Hive Hub MCP server (source: hive_hub_mcp.py, SHA-256 2a07829ed205…, standard-library Python), into ~/.hive-hub-mcp, and {{NAME}} runs it with python3. It only reads the public Hive Hubs. It checks every document's SHA-256. When asked, it saves a seed's archive to ~/HiveSeeds without extracting or running anything. Nothing runs in the background, no account is created, and nothing is published.
tagline: Ready-made AI organizations you can pull down and run with your own AI.
intro: You are connecting {{NAME}} to RAPP Hive Hub, a public catalog of RAPP Work organization seeds (ready-made AI organizations with teams, tasks and a first engagement), by adding the read-only Hive Hub MCP server under the name hive-hub. A seed is a starter package, not an activated organization or running agent: keep everything you download inert until the owner approves a plan.
steps: {{HOST_SHORT}} says what it will add and waits for your yes.
Ask “show me the RAPP Hive Hub seeds” or “pull down The AI Video Studio”.
tools_note: The version check should print hive-hub-mcp 1.0.0. Then call list_seeds with hub: "rapp-hive-hub" and show the user the organizations. get_seed explains one (teams, tasks, first engagement), resolve_chant turns a seven-word chant into candidates, and download_seed saves a seed's verified archive (ask first). To set up an organization from a seed, follow the hub's skill (get_skill) with the owner's approval.
footer: RAPP Hive Hub · browse the seeds · server: kody-w/hive-hub-mcp · pages built with ai-setup-pages
